evidence.title: Bergvall named in Sweden's World Cup squad
evidence.summary: Sweden released their 26‑player squad for the 2026 World Cup, including Lucas Bergvall. The squad will play Tunisia on 15 June.
evidence.rawExcerpt: "Lucas Bergvall has been named in what will be his first taste of a major international tournament whilst it has sadly come too soon for Dejan Kulusevski… Sweden have been drawn in Group F alongside the Netherlands, Japan and Tunisia and start their campaign against Tunisia on 15 June (3am UK) in Guadalupe, Mexico."
